Title: Connexion administrateur
Story statement: As an administrator, I want to sign in with my email and password, so that I can access my farm workspace.
Acceptance criterion 1: Given an active administrator account, when I enter the correct email and password, then I arrive at the administrator home screen.
Acceptance criterion 2: Given an incorrect email or password, when I try to sign in, then I see an access error and remain signed out.
Acceptance criterion 3: Given an expired subscription, when I sign in, then I see the subscription-expired screen.

Title: Inscription éleveur par invitation
Story statement: As a farmer, I want to create my account with an invitation, so that I can join my administrator’s farm.
Acceptance criterion 1: Given a valid invitation, when I enter my name and submit registration, then my account is created and I am signed in.
Acceptance criterion 2: Given an expired or used invitation, when I submit it, then I am told that it is no longer valid.
Acceptance criterion 3: Given an invalid registration form, when I submit it, then I see what needs correcting and no account is created.

Title: Scanner un QR d’invitation ou de connexion
Story statement: As a farmer, I want to scan an invitation or login QR code with my phone, so that I can register or access my account without typing its code.
Acceptance criterion 1: Given an invitation QR code, when I scan it, then I am taken to the invitation confirmation and registration flow.
Acceptance criterion 2: Given a login QR code, when I scan it and confirm my name, then I am signed in to the matching account.
Acceptance criterion 3: Given an unreadable, invalid, expired, or cancelled scan, when the scan ends, then I see an appropriate message and can try again.

Title: Connexion biométrique
Story statement: As a farmer, I want to sign in with biometrics on a compatible phone, so that I can return to my account more easily.
Acceptance criterion 1: Given a compatible phone and an existing account, when I choose biometric sign-in, then I can authenticate using the phone’s supported biometric method.
Acceptance criterion 2: Given an unavailable or unsuccessful biometric check, when I try to sign in, then I can use the existing QR sign-in flow instead.
Acceptance criterion 3: Given I have not enabled biometric sign-in, when I open the sign-in screen, then the app explains how to continue without it.

Title: Changer le mot de passe administrateur
Story statement: As an administrator, I want to change my password after confirming my current password, so that I can keep control of my account.
Acceptance criterion 1: Given my current password, when I enter it and a valid new password, then I receive confirmation that the password changed.
Acceptance criterion 2: Given an incorrect current password, when I submit the change, then my password remains unchanged and I see an error.
Acceptance criterion 3: Given a new password shorter than the accepted minimum, when I submit it, then I am asked to choose a valid password.

Title: Retrouver ou fermer ma session
Story statement: As a signed-in user, I want my session to be restored when I reopen the app and to be able to sign out, so that I can control access to my account.
Acceptance criterion 1: Given a valid saved session, when I reopen the app, then I return to the appropriate signed-in screen.
Acceptance criterion 2: Given an expired session, when I reopen the app, then I am asked to sign in again.
Acceptance criterion 3: Given I choose to sign out, when the action completes, then I return to the sign-in screen.

Title: Choisir la langue de l’application
Story statement: As a farmer, I want to choose French or Arabic, so that I can use the app in a language I understand.
Acceptance criterion 1: Given either available language, when I select it, then the app displays its supported text in that language.
Acceptance criterion 2: Given Arabic is selected, when I browse the app, then the layout follows right-to-left reading direction.
Acceptance criterion 3: Given I move between screens, when the language is selected, then the choice remains consistent during the session.

Title: Créer et suivre des invitations
Story statement: As an administrator, I want to create, view, and cancel farmer invitations, so that I can control who joins my farm.
Acceptance criterion 1: Given my administrator account, when I create an invitation, then I can share its QR code before it expires.
Acceptance criterion 2: Given my invitation list, when I view it, then I can distinguish active, used, and expired invitations.
Acceptance criterion 3: Given an active unused invitation, when I cancel it, then it can no longer be used to register.

Epic: Gérer mon élevage et mes accès
Title: Gérer les éleveurs de mon exploitation
Story statement: As an administrator, I want to view my farmers, issue them a login QR code, and remove their access, so that I can manage my team.
Acceptance criterion 1: Given farmers associated with my farm, when I open the farmer list, then I see their names.
Acceptance criterion 2: Given one of my farmers, when I request a login QR code, then I can share a time-limited code for that farmer.
Acceptance criterion 3: Given a farmer I manage, when I confirm removal, then that account can no longer access my farm.

Epic: Gérer mon élevage et mes accès
Title: Demander un compte administrateur
Story statement: As an administrator, I want to submit my contact details to request an administrator account, so that my access request can be reviewed.
Acceptance criterion 1: Given the access-request form, when I submit valid contact details, then I see confirmation that my request was received.
Acceptance criterion 2: Given an invalid email or missing required detail, when I submit the form, then I see what must be corrected.
Acceptance criterion 3: Given an existing pending request for the same email, when I submit another one, then I am told that a request is already pending.

Epic: Gérer mon élevage et mes accès
Title: Traiter les demandes d’accès et de renouvellement
Story statement: As an administrator responsible for account requests, I want to review, approve, or reject signup and renewal requests, so that access decisions are clear and timely.
Acceptance criterion 1: Given pending requests, when I open the request list, then I can distinguish signup requests from renewal requests and see their status.
Acceptance criterion 2: Given a pending signup request, when I approve it, then the applicant receives an administrator account and the required first-login information.
Acceptance criterion 3: Given a pending request, when I reject it, then its status changes to rejected and the decision is recorded.

Epic: Gérer mon élevage et mes accès
Title: Gérer les comptes administrateurs
Story statement: As an administrator responsible for accounts, I want to view administrator accounts, renew their access, reset their password, or remove an account, so that I can manage the service’s administrators.
Acceptance criterion 1: Given the administrator account list, when I open it, then I can see each account’s status and subscription information.
Acceptance criterion 2: Given an administrator account, when I renew its subscription or reset its password, then I see confirmation of the resulting access state.
Acceptance criterion 3: Given an administrator account selected for removal, when I confirm the action, then its access is removed and the outcome is shown.

Epic: Gérer mon élevage et mes accès
Title: Suivre mon abonnement
Story statement: As an administrator, I want to view my subscription status and request a renewal, so that I can keep access to my farm.
Acceptance criterion 1: Given an active subscription, when I open subscription details, then I see its expiry date and remaining time.
Acceptance criterion 2: Given an expired subscription, when I open the app, then I see the expired state and a way to request renewal.
Acceptance criterion 3: Given a renewal request is already pending, when I try to submit another, then I am informed that a request is already in progress.

Title: Gérer les profils de vaches comme administrateur
Story statement: As an administrator, I want to create, view, edit, and remove cow profiles, so that my herd information stays current.
Acceptance criterion 1: Given valid cow details, when I save a new profile, then it appears in my cow list.
Acceptance criterion 2: Given an existing profile, when I update its details, then the cow view shows the saved information.
Acceptance criterion 3: Given an existing profile, when I confirm removal, then the cow is removed from my list.

Title: Gérer les profils de mes vaches comme éleveur
Story statement: As a farmer, I want to view, add, and edit my cow profiles, so that I can keep my herd information up to date.
Acceptance criterion 1: Given my farm’s cows, when I open the cow list, then I see the profiles available to my account.
Acceptance criterion 2: Given a new cow and its required NFC tag, when I save its profile, then it appears in my list.
Acceptance criterion 3: Given one of my cow profiles, when I save valid edits, then the updated details appear in its profile.

Title: Identifier une vache par NFC
Story statement: As a signed-in user, I want to scan a cow’s NFC tag and open its profile, so that I can identify the animal quickly.
Acceptance criterion 1: Given a registered tag belonging to my farm, when I scan it, then I can open the matching cow profile.
Acceptance criterion 2: Given an unknown tag, when I scan it, then I am told that no matching profile was found.
Acceptance criterion 3: Given a tag registered to another farm, when I scan it, then no other farm’s profile details are shown.

Title: Rechercher et filtrer les vaches
Story statement: As an administrator, I want to search my cow list by identifier or breed and filter by appetite class, so that I can find animals needing attention.
Acceptance criterion 1: Given my cow list, when I enter an identifier or breed, then matching cows are shown.
Acceptance criterion 2: Given appetite classifications are available, when I select an appetite filter, then only cows in that class are shown.
Acceptance criterion 3: Given no cow matches my search and filter, when the results update, then I see an empty-state message.

Title: Consulter les dernières mesures
Story statement: As a signed-in user, I want to see a cow’s latest feeding and activity measurements, so that I can understand its recent behavior.
Acceptance criterion 1: Given a cow with recent measurements, when I open its detail, then I see the latest available values and their time.
Acceptance criterion 2: Given no measurement is available, when I open the detail, then I see that the data is unavailable rather than an invented value.
Acceptance criterion 3: Given a measurement cannot be loaded, when I retry, then the app either displays the result or explains the problem.

Title: Consulter l’historique journalier
Story statement: As a signed-in user, I want to view a cow’s daily measurements and select a day, so that I can compare its feeding history.
Acceptance criterion 1: Given daily records for a cow, when I open its history, then I can view the available days and measurements.
Acceptance criterion 2: Given a date with a record, when I select it, then I see the measurements for that date.
Acceptance criterion 3: Given a date without a record, when I select it, then I see that no data is available for that day.

Title: Suivre les mesures en direct
Story statement: As a signed-in user, I want to see new cow measurements appear while I view its detail, so that I can follow recent activity.
Acceptance criterion 1: Given I am viewing a cow with live updates available, when a new reading arrives, then the displayed reading is updated.
Acceptance criterion 2: Given live updates are unavailable, when I open the detail, then I can still see the latest saved reading when one exists.
Acceptance criterion 3: Given no live or saved reading is available, when I view the detail, then the app clearly indicates that state.

Title: Consulter les distributions d’aliment
Story statement: As an administrator, I want to view a cow’s recent feed-dispatch records, so that I can check what the feeder has dispensed.
Acceptance criterion 1: Given dispatch records exist, when I open the cow detail, then I can see the recent records and their available values.
Acceptance criterion 2: Given no dispatch record exists, when I open the dispatch section, then I see an empty state.
Acceptance criterion 3: Given records cannot be loaded, when I retry, then I see either the loaded records or an explanatory error.

Title: Suivre l’appétit du troupeau
Story statement: As an administrator, I want to see appetite classes and unread-alert counts across my herd, so that I can identify cows needing attention.
Acceptance criterion 1: Given appetite data is available, when I open the dashboard, then I see cows grouped or summarized by appetite class.
Acceptance criterion 2: Given unread alerts exist, when I view the dashboard, then I see their count and can open the alert list.
Acceptance criterion 3: Given appetite data is missing, when I view the dashboard, then missing data is distinguished from a normal appetite classification.

Title: Comprendre l’appétit d’une vache
Story statement: As a farmer, I want to see my cow’s appetite class, recent trend, and available explanation, so that I can follow changes in its feeding behavior.
Acceptance criterion 1: Given appetite results exist, when I open a cow detail, then I see its current class and recent trend.
Acceptance criterion 2: Given confidence or class percentages are available, when I view the result, then I can see those values with clear labels.
Acceptance criterion 3: Given appetite data is unavailable, when I open the detail, then the app states that it cannot provide a result.

Title: Obtenir une recommandation d’alimentation
Story statement: As a farmer, I want to receive a useful feeding recommendation for a cow, so that I can make an informed feeding decision.
Acceptance criterion 1: Given sufficient cow and feeding data, when I open the feeding section, then I see a recommendation and the information it is based on.
Acceptance criterion 2: Given data is insufficient, when I open the feeding section, then I see which information is unavailable instead of a fabricated recommendation.
Acceptance criterion 3: Given a recommendation cannot be produced, when I open the feeding section, then I see a clear unavailable state.

Title: Consulter une estimation d’ingestion
Story statement: As a farmer, I want to see an estimated daily feed intake for a cow, so that I can compare its estimated needs with its recorded feeding.
Acceptance criterion 1: Given a cow profile with the required details, when I request an estimate, then I see an estimated daily intake with its unit.
Acceptance criterion 2: Given required profile details are missing, when I request an estimate, then I am told which details are needed.
Acceptance criterion 3: Given no estimate is available, when I view the feeding section, then the app does not present an unverified value as fact.

Title: Régler la sensibilité des alertes d’appétit
Story statement: As an administrator, I want to choose how sensitive appetite alerts are for my farm, so that the alerts better match the herd I manage.
Acceptance criterion 1: Given appetite alert settings, when I choose a supported sensitivity, then the app shows the selected setting.
Acceptance criterion 2: Given a new appetite result, when it is evaluated, then alert behavior follows the setting I selected.
Acceptance criterion 3: Given I have not changed the setting, when an appetite result is evaluated, then the existing default behavior is preserved.

Epic: Traiter les alertes et les tâches
Title: Consulter et traiter les alertes
Story statement: As an administrator, I want to view appetite and task-completion alerts, filter read and unread alerts, and open the related cow, so that I can follow up on important events.
Acceptance criterion 1: Given alerts exist, when I open the alert list, then I see their type, time, and related cow when available.
Acceptance criterion 2: Given read and unread alerts, when I choose a status filter or mark an alert as read, then the displayed status updates.
Acceptance criterion 3: Given an alert refers to a cow, when I open it, then I can navigate to that cow’s details.

Epic: Traiter les alertes et les tâches
Title: Attribuer une tâche à un éleveur
Story statement: As an administrator, I want to assign a dated task to a farmer and optionally link it to a cow or appetite alert, so that the needed follow-up is clear.
Acceptance criterion 1: Given a farmer in my team, when I create a task with a title and type, then it appears in my task list.
Acceptance criterion 2: Given a task linked to a cow or appetite alert, when I save it, then the related item is visible from the task.
Acceptance criterion 3: Given tasks with different statuses or farmers, when I filter the list, then I see the matching tasks.

Epic: Traiter les alertes et les tâches
Title: Consulter et terminer mes tâches
Story statement: As a farmer, I want to view my pending tasks and mark them complete with an optional note or weight, so that my administrator can follow the work done.
Acceptance criterion 1: Given pending tasks assigned to me, when I open the task list, then I can see their descriptions and due dates when available.
Acceptance criterion 2: Given a task I have completed, when I submit it with an optional note or weight, then it is marked complete.
Acceptance criterion 3: Given completion is recorded, when my administrator views the task, then its completion details are available.

Epic: Traiter les alertes et les tâches
Title: Recevoir des notifications d’alertes et de tâches
Story statement: As a signed-in user, I want to be notified about relevant alerts or tasks when I am not using the app, so that I can respond promptly.
Acceptance criterion 1: Given notifications are enabled and permission is granted, when a supported alert or task is found, then I receive a notification on a supported device.
Acceptance criterion 2: Given I open a notification, when the app is available, then I am taken to the related alert, task, or list.
Acceptance criterion 3: Given notifications are disabled or unavailable, when I view notification settings, then I can see the current state and how to change it.

Epic: Traiter les alertes et les tâches
Title: Consulter mes tâches terminées
Story statement: As a farmer, I want to review tasks I have completed, so that I can remember what work was done.
Acceptance criterion 1: Given I have completed tasks, when I open task history, then I can see their titles and completion dates.
Acceptance criterion 2: Given a completed task has a note or recorded weight, when I open it, then I can review those details.
Acceptance criterion 3: Given I have not completed any tasks, when I open task history, then I see an empty state.

Title: Identifier une vache auprès de la mangeoire
Story statement: As a farmer, I want a cow’s RFID tag to identify the animal at the feeder and record its visit, so that feeding activity can be associated with the right cow.
Acceptance criterion 1: Given a recognized cow tag is held at the reader for the required time, when the visit is registered, then the visit is associated with that tag.
Acceptance criterion 2: Given the tag is unknown or the visit is too short, when the tag is removed, then no valid feeding visit is shown for that attempt.
Acceptance criterion 3: Given the feeder cannot contact the service, when a visit is attempted, then the user-facing result does not claim that a feeding request succeeded.

Title: Distribuer la quantité demandée
Story statement: As a farmer, I want the feeder to dispense the quantity returned for a recognized cow, so that feeding is adapted to the animal.
Acceptance criterion 1: Given a valid feeding response for a recognized cow, when the feeder processes it, then it dispenses the returned quantity.
Acceptance criterion 2: Given no valid response is received, when the request times out, then the feeder follows its available fallback behavior and does not report a successful response.
Acceptance criterion 3: Given a distribution is recorded, when I view the cow’s feeding details, then the available distribution record is shown.
